g.text: 2nd Most Fortified Bastion • Naval Fleet Base
THE THREE POWERS OF THE ISLES
Airspace Sovereignty, Ground Reality & Orc Fluctuations
THE UNSPOKEN DOCTRINE OF THE ISLES:
"I against my brother, my brother & I against our cousins,
our cousins and ourselves against the world."
If any continental empire lands troops on Isle soil, all three
nations unite to crush the invasion before resuming their cold war.
Air Borders vs. Surface Flux Note:
Map bounds represent Royal Airspace claimed and patrolled in the Zone.
Ground reality: Orc-controlled lands fluctuate constantly and are ~50%
larger, residing directly beneath nominal kingdom claims.
NE Scotland + Dutch Twin Spires. Border shared w/ Orcs.
Ireland, North Wales (touches Arclean) & SW Tip (Plymouth).
Free Spire; neutral bank, diplomatic haven, and spy nexus.
North/West Scotland (shared threat) + Severn/West buffer in South.
Continental Coastal Powers: Hostile to Arclean's Normandy bridgehead.
